The function is resilient: if any exception occurs (e.g. invalid input type), it will catch the error and return an empty list instead of propagating the exception. """ try: if not isinstance(html_code, str): # Non‑string input: treat as empty string. html_code = "" # Find all matches; the regex captures anything that looks like an HTML tag. return _TAG_RE.findall(html_code) except Exception: # In case of any unexpected error, return an empty list to avoid raising. return []
